title: BMS health summary (low frequency, for MPM)
description: Published retained on libre-solar/bms/{device_id}/summary by the gateway, once per window (default 15 min) and immediately when health or active faults change. Values are derived from `meas` over the window: these are the numbers an operator acts on, not a timeseries.

window_s.description: Length of the aggregation window in seconds.

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the newest `meas` in the window.

min_soc_pct.description: Lowest SoC in the window. Repeatedly low values point to an undersized system.

cell_imbalance_mv.description: Largest max-minus-min cell voltage seen in the window.

max_temp_c.description: Highest of all cell, IC and MOSFET temperatures in the window.

equivalent_cycles.description: Lifetime full-cycle equivalents counted by the gateway: discharged Ah / nominal capacity.

soh_pct.description: Estimated state of health. The firmware does not report SoH; null until an estimate is available.
